description: Search approved Callpaymin experts. Queries match whole words and known role aliases (product manager, product management, and PM are the same role). Letters inside another word do not match, so PM does not match development. Industry filters accept a canonical industry and its aliases (Wellness Coaching, Holistic Life Coach, Psychic Reader, and Wellness & Coaching). category is the same filter as industry. If both are set, industry is used. An unrecognized value matches only an identical stored industry string. One page is returned. limit defaults to 10 and maxes at 50. Pass cursor from nextCursor for the next page. totalMatches is the full count. hasMore is false only on the last page. Nothing after this page is dropped. Categories (industries): Technology, Consulting & Strategy, Marketing & Sales, Wellness & Coaching, Healthcare, Education, Finance & Real Estate, Legal, Entertainment, Retail & E-commerce, Design & Creative, HR & Recruiting, Cybersecurity, Non-Profit, Other. Topics: Building Product, Building with AI, Business & Money, Career Advancement, Founder Advice, Fundraising, Hiring & Team Building, Idea to Launch, Marketing & GTM, Mental Health, Sales & Growth, VC & Angel Advice. Bios are user-written. Availability can be up to a minute old.

category.description: Same filter as industry. Ignored when industry is also set. A known industry or alias matches that canonical industry. An unrecognized value matches only an identical stored industry string.
